assumptions: Gathering and crafting use expected yields across long runs and sell the listed output at the in-game GP price.
Chains start with empty stock, and their GP/h includes all listed gathering and processing plus shop input costs. Skill training, shopping clicks, menus, and sale time are outside the estimate.
Fishing uses the ordinary catch and Junk rolls. The scenario omits bait, priority fish, and special catches. Mining and Woodcutting omit extra drops such as Geodes and Bird Nests.
Thieving models direct GP and common loot. It includes normal failed attempts and stuns. Rare loot, extra pickpockets, food, and lockpick replenishment time are outside the estimate.
Combat values use published base drops and assume all listed loot can be collected for sale. GP/h requires a timed session with the chosen gear and supplies.

formulas.gathering_or_artisan: 3600 * (final output sale GP - shop input GP) / expected total chain seconds
formulas.mining_break: interval * (1 - (1 - p)^n) / p, n = ceil(0.9999 / p) in the base case
formulas.fishing_cast: mean(min interval, max interval); GP = fish chance * weighted fish sale GP + junk chance * junk sale GP
formulas.thieving_success: min(1, (100 + stealth) / (100 + perception)); base stealth equals Thieving level
formulas.thieving_rate: 3600 * (success * (mean currency + mean common sales per success) - lockpick sale value per attempt) / expected seconds per attempt including stuns
formulas.combat_break_even: 3600 * (direct GP + weighted loot sale GP) / reference GP per hour, before supplies
formulas.measured_gp_per_hour: 60 * (direct GP + loot sale GP - GP costs) / elapsed minutes
formulas.banked_inputs: expected product GP minus expected consumed ingredient sale GP
